meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后,你的 AI 助手能通过 Matrix 聊天软件收发消息,用户可在 Matrix 房间或私聊中与它对话。需要为机器人创建一个独立的 Matrix 账号。
howto.when: 当你在 /setup 流程中,或运行 /manage-channels 命令来连接 Matrix 渠道时,此技能会执行添加步骤。

say.text: 帮我添加 Matrix 聊天渠道。
say.note: 执行复制适配器、注册、安装等步骤。

say.text: 给机器人配置独立的 Matrix 账号。
say.note: 引导创建账号并选择登录方式。

say.text: 重新跑一遍 Matrix 添加流程。
say.note: 操作幂等,可安全重复执行。

howto.what_en: This skill integrates Matrix into NanoClaw via the Chat SDK bridge. After setup, your AI can exchange messages in Matrix rooms and DMs. A dedicated bot account is required because Matrix cannot message your own account.
howto.when_en: Used when you are in the /setup flow or run /manage-channels to connect a Matrix channel; it performs the integration steps.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix chat channel for me.
say_en.note: Runs the steps to copy the adapter and register it.

say_en.text: Set up a separate Matrix account for the bot.
say_en.note: Walks you through creating the account and entering credentials.
